```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.5)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(pkgload::load_all("..", quiet = TRUE, export_all = FALSE))
library(ggplot2)
a <- analyse(params$data)
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), 100 * x)
palette <- c(desktop = "#9aa5b1", mobile = "#d64545")
```

Every number below is computed by the `funnellens` R package from the raw export `r a$dataset$export`
(`r a$dataset$period_start` to `r a$dataset$period_end`, a 1-in-`r round(1 / a$dataset$sample_rate)` sample).
Knitting this file from a clean checkout reproduces it exactly; CI does that with `make report`.
The formulas are in `contract/questions.md`.
